text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Open-source nature and strong security/encryption practices",
    "Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plan",
    "Cross-platform availability and reliable synchronization",
    "Ease of quickly creating basic entries like logins and secure notes",
    "Comprehensive item types including logins, cards, identities, and SSH keys",
    "Self-hosting option for advanced users and organizations"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "User interface can feel less polished or intuitive than competitors",
    "Organization and sharing features can be confusing, especially for new teams",
    "Switching between personal vault and organization admin console is disjointed",
    "Custom fields are not prominently visible, requiring scrolling to find",
    "Free organization limits (e.g., 2 users, 2 collections) are restrictive for evaluation",
    "Some advanced features (like TOTP) are locked behind premium subscriptions"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.5
}

pros: Open-source nature and strong security/encryption practices
Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plan
Ease of quickly creating basic entries like logins and secure notes
Comprehensive item types including logins, cards, identities, and SSH keys
Self-hosting option for advanced users and organizations
cons: User interface can feel less polished or intuitive than competitors
Organization and sharing features can be confusing, especially for new teams
Switching between personal vault and organization admin console is disjointed
Custom fields are not prominently visible, requiring scrolling to find
Free organization limits (e.g., 2 users, 2 collections) are restrictive for evaluation
Some advanced features (like TOTP) are locked behind premium subscriptions
